scope: Documentary Interface lexical/structural evidence only; no lexer, grammar, parser or runtime acceptance

citations.finding: Programs are held in BASIC strings. Two capital letters identify instructions; lower-case padding and lower-case comments are described. Semicolon/colon separators are required; spaces alone do not separate commands.
Single quotes are recommended within BASIC string payloads. Binary/hex notation and postfix expressions are illustrated. Do not infer digit splitting from collapsed numeric spacing in examples.
Operators consume stack values; the arithmetic table includes inconsistent spacing/omitted operators and unclear Min/Max capitalisation. Preserve the source question rather than adopting a tokenizer.
BU draw/change routines use two bracket groups with a semicolon before the first. Their execution contexts differ.
The button discussion explicitly forbids a semicolon after the final bracket group; the general terminator rule cannot be applied blindly.
IF has a bracketed routine and postfix test. Backslash means not-equal; ampersand and vertical bar are logical operators.
UI defines user instructions with a two-capital-letter name and parameter functions P1 through P9. Custom names must not collide with existing instructions.
SZ/ZV preserve zone data; ZV is documented for draw/change bracket contexts, not arbitrary global evaluation.
HyperText embeds active-zone markup in separate text data; it is not automatically an Interface or BASIC token stream.
